verdicts.reason: Both split the three chips: FREE ENTRY is stranded under the date block while ALL AGES and TASTINGS sit apart above the RSVP button. Both also wedge 'Saturday 21 June' tightly under the subtitle and leave the central column off-centre. A is the cleaner of the two. B's 'Reserve a spot' line almost touches the partner-mark box, and its venue line breaks awkwardly as 'Harbour / Rooftop, Pier 9'.
